payload.entry: Implemented synthetic-fixture month and queue cards plus the daily plan chip. Verified plugin build; 167 bank/day-strip/build regression tests passed; docs inventory and manifest validation passed. Synthetic text captures are attached as file:explicit:406f620cf619e73fcdb56669. Deployment and closure remain blocked by the protected uncommitted bob-ledger-tools build from active author bob-cli-k3.5.1.3; the plugin deployment runbook requires waiting for that author, and no force overwrite was attempted. Docs lint still reports eight word-budget failures; the base docs reproduce the same eight.

Rollout attempt 2026-11-11/12: `npx --yes --package=node@22 -- npm test -- scripts/test-obsidian-startup-smoke.cjs` timed out after 1h (monitor 9enbyvbd39z0, exit -9), while the configured full test list was still progressing at test 1867; no assertion failure was reported. The package test script appends the requested filename to its full explicit test list, so this command does not filter to the smoke unit test. The chain stopped before help, isolated smoke, build check, sync, or deployed smoke; neither `/tmp/obsidian-smoke-isolated.json` nor `/tmp/obsidian-smoke-deployed.json` exists. Retrying with a 2h budget.
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Make the rollout documentation targeted startup smoke test command actually run only `scripts/test-obsidian-startup-smoke.cjs`, or document the full-suite cost; `npm test -- <file>` currently runs the full package test list.

Rollout resume 2026-11-12: fetched origin/master and fast-forwarded the opened bob-plugins checkout to d94c6bb; protected deploy commit d532aad and earlier landed build e8a776e are reachable. Clean sync on the landed checkout passed without force (0 copied, 0 skipped, 3 unchanged); after restoring UI changes, dry-run previewed only bob-ledger-tools, and the final non-force sync copied manifest.json, main.js, and styles.css (3 copied, 0 skipped, 0 unchanged; version 1.111.1). Isolated smoke /tmp/obsidian-smoke-isolated-final.json passed from d94c6bb: 364 ms layout-ready, all four editor cases, 40.3 MiB heap, no exceptions/rejections/crashes. Post-sync deployed-vault smoke /tmp/obsidian-smoke-deployed-final.json passed: 344 ms, 10/10 plugins synced, zero drift or missing plugins, bob-ledger-tools 1.111.1 synced, all four editor cases, no exceptions/rejections/crashes. npm run docs:check exits 1 on docs/reference/plugins/bob-ledger-tools.md:1 at 6221 words versus cap 6000; prior phase verification established the same word-budget baseline with the original plugin documentation restored. Corrected the rollout guide to run the focused smoke test with node --test and the full suite with npm test. Full npm test is pending monitored verification; earlier pre-refactor runs timed out without assertion failures.

Rollout resume 2026-11-12: npx --yes --package=node@22 -- npm test timed out after 3h 0m 5s; monitor mna01jdbzg58, retained log file:monitor-retained-log:mna01jdbzg58, diagnostics file:monitor-diagnostic-manifest:mna01jdbzg58.
